name: Where the Day Springs Red
source:
Gum and their chaotic band of childhood friends reunite at the old ranch they spent summers at as kids for a final hurrah now that Marshall's grandparents are retiring.  But the idyllic autumn vibes aren't to last. Something is out there in the woods... and once darkness falls, its hunt begins... staining the night a brilliant red.

Will any of them survive to see the sun rise?

[From [url=https://justacarrot.itch.io/where-the-day-springs-red]itch.io[/url]]
